name: Dyslexie Font Accessibility
author: Christian Boer

sections.description:
Dyslexie Font Accessibility is a comprehensive accessibility plugin that makes reading easier for people with dyslexia. The plugin adds a floating accessibility menu to your website where visitors can customize their reading experience.

Features

  • Dyslexie Font – The scientifically designed typeface that improves readability for people with dyslexia
  • Apply to Body or All – Choose to apply the font only to body text or to all text including headers
  • Font Size Control – Adjustable text size from 9px to 48px (default: 18px)
  • Letter Spacing – Customizable letter and word spacing (0-10px)
  • Line Height (Interline) – Adjustable line height from 120% to 220% (default: 165%)
  • Color Selection – 10 preset text colors for optimal contrast
  • Focus Mode – Immersive reader that displays page content in a clean, distraction-free overlay
  • Slide Reader – Canvas-based reading tool with smooth Gaussian curve animation for guided reading

How It Works

Once activated, the plugin displays an “Aa” button on the right side of your website. Visitors can click this button to open the accessibility menu and customize their reading experience. All settings are saved in the visitor’s browser, so their preferences persist across sessions.

Admin Settings

Website administrators can configure:

  • Default Font State – Choose whether Dyslexie Font is enabled or disabled by default for new visitors

Go to Settings → Dyslexie Font in your WordPress admin to configure these options.

About Dyslexie Font

Dyslexie Font was designed by Christian Boer, a graphic designer with dyslexia. The font uses unique letter shapes to prevent confusion between similar characters, making reading easier and more enjoyable for people with dyslexia.

Learn more at dyslexiefont.com

Requirements

  • WordPress 5.0 or higher
  • PHP 7.4 or higher
  • Modern browser with WOFF font support

Additional Information

Support

For support, please visit dyslexiefont.com or contact us through the website.

Credits

  • Dyslexie Font designed by Christian Boer
  • Plugin developed by Christian Boer and Claude code

Privacy

This plugin does not collect, store, or transmit any personal data. All user preferences are stored locally in the visitor’s browser using localStorage.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the dyslexie-font-plugin folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress
  3. Optionally, go to Settings → Dyslexie Font to configure the default font state
sections.faq:
Can I change the default settings?

Yes! Go to Settings → Dyslexie Font in your WordPress admin. You can choose whether the font is enabled or disabled by default for new visitors.

Will the plugin affect my website’s navigation menu?

No. The website navigation menu is specifically excluded from font changes to maintain your site’s design integrity.

What’s the difference between “Body” and “All” modes?

  • Body mode: Applies Dyslexie Font only to body text (paragraphs, list items, blockquotes, table cells)
  • All mode: Applies Dyslexie Font to everything on the page including headers, buttons, links, and all other text elements

Do visitor settings persist?

Yes. All settings are saved in the visitor’s browser using localStorage, so their preferences are remembered across sessions and page visits.

Is the plugin GDPR compliant?

Yes. The plugin only uses localStorage (browser-side storage) and does not collect, store, or transmit any personal data to external servers.

Can I customize the appearance of the accessibility menu?

The menu is designed to be consistent and accessible. However, developers can override styles using CSS with high specificity selectors.

The font doesn’t appear on my site. What’s wrong?

The plugin includes the Dyslexie Font files. If the font doesn’t appear, check your browser’s developer console for any 404 errors related to font files. Make sure the plugin was uploaded correctly and the /fonts/ folder contains the .woff files.

2.9.1

  • Fixed: “All” mode now applies Dyslexie Font to all text elements including headers, buttons, quotes, spans, links, and inputs
  • Clear distinction between Body mode (only paragraphs/lists) and All mode (entire page)

  • Fixed: Website navigation menu is never affected by Body or All mode
  • Fixed: Aa button keeps fixed size regardless of font settings
  • New SVG logo for menu footer and admin settings

2.8.0

  • Fixed: Menu no longer changes font when Body or All mode is selected
  • Fixed: Headers now correctly get Dyslexie Font in All mode
  • New footer design: Reset button on left, Logo on right

  • Bold, italic, and span text inside paragraphs now correctly use Dyslexie Font
  • Larger logo in menu footer

  • Added WordPress admin settings page
  • Administrators can now set default font state (ON/OFF) for new visitors
  • Interline slider range extended to 220%

2.5.0

  • Auto-extracts page text for Slide Reader and Focus Mode
  • Improved text extraction algorithm

  • Added Focus Mode (Immersive Reader)
  • Added Slide Reader
  • Improved font application targeting

1.0.0
